title: Stopping distance from v² = u² + 2as
caption: Braking at 5.0 m s⁻² from 25 m s⁻¹, the car stops after 5 s. Setting v = 0 in v² = u² + 2as gives s = 25² ÷ (2 × 5) = 62.5 m: the area under the velocity line.
alt: Position and velocity against time for a car braking from 25 metres per second to rest in 5 seconds, covering 62.5 metres.
description: Velocity falls from 25 to 0 m s⁻¹ in 5 s.
Position rises along a curve that flattens as the car slows, reaching 62.5 m.
